capabilities.name: Revenue leakage detection
capabilities.operational_scope: Evaluates rate mismatches, unbilled jobs, duplicate billings, and orphan records against approved master service agreements and pricing tables with exact Decimal arithmetic.
capabilities.synthetic_distinction: Verified across synthetic fixtures (oilfield, clean control, and differential randomized test cases). Live customer data ingestion is locked pending pilot authorization.

capabilities.name: Invoice and ticket reconciliation
capabilities.operational_scope: Cross-references equipment run tickets and service tickets against generated invoices, detecting discrepancy codes (RATE_MISMATCH, UNBILLED_JOB, ORPHAN_INVOICE).
capabilities.synthetic_distinction: Deterministic rule engine operational; inputs currently supplied via authenticated JSON payloads or synthetic CSVs.

capabilities.name: Duplicate labor prevention
capabilities.operational_scope: Identifies duplicate labor records sharing role, date, and job boundaries; isolates duplicates and places exposure into withheld_unresolved_usd rather than potential recovery.
capabilities.synthetic_distinction: Operational logic verified: same role/date cannot inflate billable hours ($0.00 confirmed recovery).

capabilities.name: Equipment-hour discrepancies
capabilities.operational_scope: Detects unbilled hours, operational variance, and overbilling on hourly equipment rentals (e.g. pressure pumping, frac units).
capabilities.synthetic_distinction: Calculations strictly mathematical with exact cent resolution; non-synthetic ERP sync connectors not yet live.

capabilities.name: Fleet maintenance findings
capabilities.operational_scope: Towing and commercial motor carrier compliance rules evaluate CDL, annual vehicle inspection, and winch maintenance logs in test fixtures.
capabilities.synthetic_distinction: Implemented in specialized compliance rule sets; website UI currently connects towing audit via synthetic fixed fixtures.

capabilities.name: Multi-month historical analysis
capabilities.operational_scope: Processes 36-month audit timelines without degradation, memory leakage, or order-dependent finding drift.
capabilities.synthetic_distinction: Matches independent golden oracle ($385.00 exposure, $150.00 withheld, $0.00 confirmed recovery).

capabilities.name: Continuous monitoring
capabilities.operational_scope: POST /v1/dispater/observations records observations with fail-closed schema validation and non-delegable effect lock (effect: NONE).
capabilities.synthetic_distinction: Observation storage and advisory feedback operational; live stream webhook ingestion from external industrial telemetry is gated.

capabilities.name: Evidence-backed dashboards
capabilities.operational_scope: DispaterReconciliationConsole renders 8-stage finding inspection, 5-step XAELI explanations, SHA-256 evidence digests, and HMAC-Bound v2 receipts.
capabilities.synthetic_distinction: Full-stack round-trip verified between TanStack Start frontend and FastAPI backend.

capabilities.name: Tenant isolation
capabilities.operational_scope: Bearer token SHA-256 hashing matched against explicit tenant grants; cross-tenant query attempts return uniform 403; SQLite database path traversal blocked.
capabilities.synthetic_distinction: Multi-tenant authorization logic is live, fully covered by 33 dedicated security unit tests.

capabilities.name: Customer pilot readiness
capabilities.operational_scope: Onboarding schemas, retention policies, CSV formula-injection defense, and non-delegable authority constraints established.
capabilities.synthetic_distinction: Engine and safeguards are complete. Production release authority remains on HOLD pending human product owner authorization.
